title: Doozy Vape Co Fruit Crush 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The classic soft drink in vape form, Fruit Crush is bursting with juicy berry flavour layered over a cool and refreshing streak of crushed Ice. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
